scope.safe_stopping_measure: Observable proxy only: every required fact and indispensable caveat is present at each rendered stopping point.

run_policy.repeat_semantics: Three total runs per host; the baseline run is run 1.
hard_fail_conditions: An indispensable warning is omitted or deferred.
A response contradicts an operative source fact.
A later qualification silently makes an earlier stopping point materially false.
A response gives an unsafe instruction.
run_policy.case_result_rule: Any behavioral FAIL in any required run fails that case for that host. Missing activation or internal-state traces may produce UNVERIFIED only for those dimensions; they do not erase an observable behavioral FAIL.

tokenization: Remove Markdown punctuation and split included prose at whitespace.
Count a token when it contains at least one English letter or digit.
Count contractions and hyphenated compounds with no whitespace as one word.
Count compact dates, times, numbers, and code-like tokens with no whitespace as one word.
Count spaced dates and times by whitespace token.
Do not count standalone symbols or punctuation without a letter or digit.
Remove inline-code backticks and count the code content by the same rule.
accumulation: Add all counted At a glance and In context prose for the active topic.
A targeted branch inherits and adds to the active topic total.
Direct In context entry is counted once.
At depth prose is outside the hard cap.
Only indispensable warning text and necessary correction repair text receive their defined exemptions.

rubric.behavioral_conformance: Score required facts, caveats, order, budgets, corrections, and prohibited output from rendered responses.
rubric.activation: PASS requires host evidence that the expected skill loaded or remained inactive. Without a trace, activation is UNVERIFIED; behavior is scored separately.
rubric.internal_state: Without a host trace, selected view, branch focus, and topic reset may be UNVERIFIED. Their rendered consequences remain pass/fail.
rubric.clarification: A focused question is excluded control dialogue only when it contains no answer, recommendation, rationale, or implementation detail beyond an indispensable warning.
rubric.additive_expansion: Every sentence or bullet in an expansion must add a new fact, qualification, consequence, action, evidence item, or relationship.
rubric.hidden_reversal: A later qualification fails if it makes an earlier operative claim materially false without the correction procedure.
rubric.targeted_branch: The branch inherits the active topic count, uses its shallowest complete view, excludes sibling branches, and does not advance the parent view.
rubric.correction: The repair starts the next relevant response, identifies and withdraws the error, states it was wrong or incomplete, replaces it, and updates changed consequences or actions. Only necessary repair text is exempt.
rubric.warning: A material warning appears before the related action or conclusion and may exceed a budget only as far as indispensable safety content requires.
rubric.purposeful_at_depth: Each section supports a requested fact, evidence need, alternative, exception, procedure, implementation concern, or necessary consequence.
rubric.non_fit: Procedures preserve complete step order, controlling legal text remains unchanged with separate non-controlling explanation, and narrative preserves sequence, pacing, and voice.
